# Ruler Square

> Free US calculators for building materials, landscaping, home systems (HVAC/power/water) and 2026 home project cost budgets. Every calculator shows its formula, worked example and reference tables, rounds material orders up to real buying units, runs locally in the browser with no accounts, and offers a free embeddable widget.

## Citation

Results, formulas and reference tables may be quoted with attribution and a link to the page. Full standards and formulas: https://rulersquare.com/methodology/

## Calculators by category

- [Construction calculators](https://rulersquare.com/construction-calculators/): concrete, bags, steps, Sonotubes, mortar, self-leveler, framing, stairs, balusters, wainscoting, trim, roofing, metal roofing, gutters, drywall, tile, grout, thinset, siding, brick, rebar and unit conversions
- [Landscaping calculators](https://rulersquare.com/landscaping-calculators/): gravel, pea gravel, decomposed granite, crushed stone, sand, topsoil, compost, fill dirt, mulch, river rock, raised garden beds, grass seed, sod, pavers, retaining walls, acreage and pools
- [Home systems & energy calculators](https://rulersquare.com/home-systems-calculators/): room AC & heating BTU, mini-split sizing, firewood cords, backup generator wattage, water heater size, dehumidifier pints and bathroom exhaust fan CFM
- [Project cost calculators](https://rulersquare.com/cost-calculators/): 2026 installed budgets for concrete slabs, patios, driveways, roofs, siding, flooring, countertops, decks, fences, retaining walls, French drains and home additions

## Most used

- [Concrete Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/concrete-calculator/): cubic yards, 40–80 lb bags and cost for slabs, footings, columns, steps and curbs
- [Gravel Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/gravel-calculator/): tons, cubic yards and dump truck loads by area and depth
- [Square Footage Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/square-footage-calculator/): rectangles, circles, triangles and trapezoids summed across sections
- [Raised Bed Soil Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/raised-bed-soil-calculator/): cubic feet, cubic yards, bags and 60/30/10 blend
- [BTU Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/btu-calculator/): room cooling/heating BTU, AC tonnage and mini-split sizing
- [Gutter Size Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/gutter-size-calculator/): 5" vs. 6" gutters and downspouts from roof area, pitch and rainfall
